page.title: Sometimes it is enough for someone simply to be there.
page.subtitle: HappyDate Care is a space for support, calm and a human approach — even in a world of technology.
page.intro: Here you can ask a question, share a concern or write whenever something is unclear. We care not only about how the platform works, but also about the comfort of the people using it.
page.approach: We do not rely on automatic replies. We read messages, understand context and respond like people. Technology matters — but relationships matter more.
page.closing: If something worries you, makes you wonder or you simply need help, we are here.
page.response: We reply as quickly as possible, with care and respect.
